```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
```

The published paper is **de Souza et al. (2025), “capivara: a spectral-based
segmentation method for IFU data cubes”, MNRAS 539, 3166–3179**, DOI
[10.1093/mnras/staf688](https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/staf688), arXiv
[2410.21962](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21962).

## Status

The repository contains the available real-data panels and research scripts.
The original 2025 figure pipeline is not yet available as a single reproducible
command. The [Examples](examples.html) page shows the current MaNGA results.

## Citation

Use the package citation:

```{r citation, eval=FALSE}
citation("capivara")
```
